text: The online shopping features of the app is fine but the ebook reader is buggy. It is unusable . While going to the next page the app freezes frequently . In many cases the app even fails to load the ebooks properly. Highlights cannot be removed as the X button doesn't work. Clicking on reference numbers in ebooks directs to the wrong page. Besides, there should an option to download the ebooks on the app to read offline. If these issues are fixed then it will much better to use.

I recently bought 7 books from the Rokomari app, and overall, it was a good experience. The biggest plus was the fast delivery—I received all my books within 2 days, which is impressive. The books were fresh and in good condition, and the packaging was normal and acceptable. The app itself is easy to use, and the ordering process was smooth without any hassle.However, I do feel that some books are slightly expensive compared to expectations.

The delivery process of this platform appears to be unreliable. In my experience, I placed an order, and the delivery date was initially promised to be within four days. However, after the four-day period, I was informed that the delivery would be delayed. After eight days, they further notified me that the item was out of stock and subsequently canceled my order. Based on this experience, I would not recommend using this platform for anything other than purchasing books.

Very disappointing delivery and extra charge policy! The delivery fee, platform fee, and cash handling fee on this app are often higher than the actual product price, making it impossible to buy small items. What is the point of a small discount or voucher when other fees end up taking more? These hidden charges should be reduced considering everyday buyers.
